prompts.noopi: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D skeletal-animation parts atlas for a mobile app splash. Character identity reference: the attached NOOPI violet plush cat only. Preserve exact giant half-lidded pale lavender eyes, mischievous curved smile, deep violet plush fur, triangular asymmetric ears with pink inner ears and premium soft 3D toy shading. Generate one transparent landscape atlas, ideally 1536x1024, arranged in EXACTLY THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows (six equal square cells). The torso must remain visibly complete and rounded with a narrow plush neck; no wounds, holes or joint sockets. Top-middle: character's left arm as an isolated complete short plush arm with mitten paw, pointing straight DOWN, rounded shoulder at TOP CENTER and hand at bottom. Top-right: mirrored matching RIGHT arm pointing straight DOWN, rounded shoulder top center. Bottom-right: isolated curved plush CAT TAIL, attachment at bottom-left of its silhouette, curling upward. Each limb is a complete soft rounded capsule suitable for being overlapped behind the torso to hide the attachment. NO other pieces, no whole standing cat, no extra bodies or heads, no face on limbs, no props, no dice. ALL pieces match the same frontal camera, colors, light direction and scale of detail. High quality soft plush 3D render with restrained violet edge light, balanced bright face lighting, smooth clean alpha edges. Six parts neatly CENTERED within the exact 3x2 invisible grid. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no borders, no floor, no scenery, no cast shadows, no background, genuine alpha transparency.
